findings.current: Orientez l’agent. Entrée envoie maintenant · Échap arrête
findings.proposed: Infléchissez l’agent. Entrée envoie maintenant · Échap arrête
findings.reason: One English verb, two French verbs: « orienter » here, « infléchir » in the two other fr rows that render English « steer ». The round-1 independent audit rated the same value MAJOR (FR-EXT-01): « orienter » with a person as its object can read as to induct/orient someone, while the placeholder is shown during a running turn and means what you type now steers it. The round-2 audit verified the fix to « Infléchissez l’agent » at d082bd95; remediation commit 5ffc6a5a78 (design review D3) reverted it to « Orientez l’agent », citing the French auditor’s adjudicated form. I searched the repository receipts and the PR thread for that adjudication and found no record of it; the only recorded adjudication is FR-EXT-01, which rated the same value MAJOR and fixed it to « Infléchissez ». On the current bytes the meaning is clear and the design review adjudicated the form, so this re-bind records a minor glossary-consistency drift rather than re-raising the major; if the team still treats FR-EXT-01 as binding, restore the proposed value and re-run the one-value delta audit. Either way one spelling must win and the glossary should record the decision.
findings.disposition: regression of a prior major; non-gating as recorded here, escalated to the manager for a one-line decision.
